questions.stem_text: All of the following are examples of hydrolysis EXCEPT

options.A: conversion of fats to fatty acids and glycerol
options.B: conversion of proteins to amino acids
options.C: conversion of starch to simple sugars
options.D: conversion of pyruvic acid to acetyl CoA

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - conversion of pyruvic acid to acetyl CoA

questions.stem_text:
Keystone species are thought to have profound effects on the structure and composition of
ecological communities because they

options.A: are more abundant than most other species in their communities
options.B: tend to reduce diversity by eliminating food resources for other species
options.C: are the largest species in their communities
options.D: are the most aggressive species in their communities
options.E: are the only species capable of reproduction

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - are more abundant than most other species in their communities

A deck of playing cards is thoroughly shuffled and a card is drawn from the deck. What is
the probability that the card drawn is the ace of diamonds?
Cardiopulmonary bypass temperature does not affect postoperative euthyroid sick syndrome?
questions.answer_explanation: The results of this study suggest that normothermic CPB does not prevent the development of the "euthyroid sick syndrome" during and after CPB. Despite these changes in thyroid function, most patients in both groups had a normal postoperative recovery.

questions.stem_text: Ultrasound in squamous cell carcinoma of the penis; a useful addition to clinical staging?
questions.answer_explanation: While ultrasound examination is inexpensive and easily done, it is not accurate enough for staging small penile cancers located at the glans penis. However, for larger tumors ultrasound can be a useful addition to physical examination by delineating reliably the anatomic relations of the tumor to structures such as the tunica albuginea, corpus cavernosum, and urethra.

questions.stem_text: Factors determining the survival of nasopharyngeal carcinoma with lung metastasis alone: does combined modality treatment benefit?
questions.answer_explanation: Age \leq 45 years, DFI>1 year, and the combined therapy were good prognostic factors for NPC patients with lung metastasis(es) alone. The combination of local therapy and the basic chemotherapy should be considered for these patients with DFI>1 year.

questions.stem_text: Does base deficit predict mortality in patients with severe traumatic brain injury?
questions.answer_explanation: Although BD is correlated with GCS at presentation and RTS, it is not a reliable prognostic marker for outcome and mortality in patients with isolated TBI.

questions.stem_text: Can the condition of the cell microenvironment of mediastinal lymph nodes help predict the risk of metastases in non-small cell lung cancer?
questions.answer_explanation: The preliminary results of this study suggest that this approach may be helpful as an independent tumor staging factor. It is also worth noting that part of the staging process could also be based on features describing the immune cells in the peripheral blood.
